title: Rewind Comparison Configuration
statement: Given a positive number $k$ of work tapes, two designated work tapes, a configuration in the run, rewind, or done phase, a Boolean verdict $v$, and a natural number $r$, the resulting configuration has state rewind carrying $v$. The head positions on the two designated tapes are each increased by $r-1$, and all other head positions and configuration fields are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes
A configuration in one of the three flag phases
